Perform an evidence-first tire/handling audit for the reported Showcase Circuit symptom: with keyboard steering, the 2025 BMW M5 can plow straight through a corner unless speed is very low. Focus on TireModel, WheelDynamics slip-angle relaxation, combined slip, load sensitivity, lateral-force peak/post-peak behavior, and force projection at large steer angles. Treat AGENTS.md, PHYSICS_CONVENTIONS.md, and M5_VALIDATION.md as hard constraints.

Do NOT increase base grip just to make the car turn. Quantify whether the current tire model is behaving plausibly at useful steering angles versus absurd full-lock/high-speed inputs. Add a deterministic diagnostic/regression test if it exposes missing coverage. Patch tire physics only if there is a clear model defect independent of keyboard input; otherwise leave tire calibration unchanged and make the result advisory/test-only. Run test:tire, conventions, relevant cornering/transient tests, strict M5 validation, and build for any behavior change.
